title: LLM Serving — Request anatomy
description: Where a request's time and tokens go: latency distributions, prefill vs queue, depth effects, token shapes, prefix cache, speculative decoding and live slot state.

panels.title: TTFT distribution
panels.description: llm_time_to_first_token_seconds buckets, increase per interval: arrival → first token (OTel gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token / vLLM). Buckets reach 3600 s so full-window prefills are not clipped into +Inf.

panels.title: Inter-chunk latency distribution
panels.description: llm_inter_chunk_latency_seconds: one observation per gap between consecutive token-bearing SSE chunks (AIPerf/GenAI-Perf inter_token_latency). With speculative decoding a chunk can carry several tokens, so gaps are bimodal.

panels.title: TPOT distribution
panels.description: llm_time_per_output_token_seconds: predicted_ms / (predicted_n − 1) per request (vLLM time_per_output_token_seconds, MLPerf TPOT).

panels.title: ITL p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Quantiles of llm_inter_chunk_latency_seconds (gap-weighted: long requests contribute more observations). Recorded 5 m p95/p99: llm:itl_seconds.

panels.title: Recorded quantiles (5 m and 30 m)
panels.description: llm:ttft_seconds:p95, llm:e2e_seconds:p95 and llm:tpot_seconds:p95 at both recorded windows. 30 m is steadier under sparse single-slot traffic; 5 m reacts faster.

panels.title: Mean TTFT = queue + prefill
panels.description: Mean per request over the interval: rate(x_sum)/rate(x_count) for llm_queue_wait_seconds and llm_prefill_seconds (timings.prompt_ms), stacked; the line is mean TTFT. Queue dominates at -np 1 under concurrency; prefill dominates for long, uncached prompts.

targets.expr: sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_queue_wait_seconds_sum{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_queue_wait_seconds_count{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_prefill_seconds_sum{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_prefill_seconds_count{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_time_to_first_token_seconds_count{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prefill p50 / p95 / p99 and prefill tokens/s
panels.description: llm_prefill_seconds quantiles (timings.prompt_ms, uncached tokens only) and llm:prefill_tokens_per_second:rate5m (native prompt_tokens_total / prompt_seconds_total) on the right axis.

panels.title: Context depth vs TPOT
panels.description: Mean context held at request end (llamacpp_request_context_depth_tokens, log release n_tokens; left) against TPOT p50 (right). Decode slows with attended depth (3–5× at a full window on this host).

targets.expr: sum by (server, model) (rate(llamacpp_request_context_depth_tokens_sum{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (server, model) (rate(llamacpp_request_context_depth_tokens_count{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Context depth distribution
panels.description: llamacpp_request_context_depth_tokens buckets: tokens in the slot when each request released it (input + output).

panels.title: Context-limit hits (range)
panels.description: increase(llamacpp_context_limit_hits_total[$__range]): requests whose release line reported truncated = 1 (context window exhausted, not max_tokens).

panels.title: Mean tokens per request by type
panels.description: rate(llm_request_tokens_sum)/rate(llm_request_tokens_count) per type: input (= prompt_n + cache_n, ISL), cached, prefill (uncached), output (OSL, incl. reasoning), reasoning.

panels.title: Token p50 / p95 by type
panels.description: histogram_quantile over llm_request_tokens by type (ISL = input, OSL = output).

panels.title: ISL distribution (input tokens)
panels.description: llm_request_tokens{type="input"} buckets: full input length per request, cached + uncached.

panels.title: OSL distribution (output tokens)
panels.description: llm_request_tokens{type="output"} buckets.

panels.title: Reasoning share and requested budget
panels.description: llm:reasoning_token_share:rate5m = reasoning / output tokens (left). Mean requested max_tokens (llm_request_max_tokens, right).

targets.expr: sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_request_max_tokens_sum{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_request_max_tokens_count{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prefix-cache hit ratio
panels.description: llm:prefix_cache_hit_ratio:rate5m = cached / (cached + evaluated) prompt tokens from native llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total and prompt_tokens_total (token-weighted; vLLM prefix_cache_hits / prefix_cache_queries).

panels.title: Cached vs evaluated prompt tokens/s
panels.description: rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total) and rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total), stacked.

panels.title: Acceptance rate and mean acceptance length τ
panels.description: llm:spec_acceptance_rate:rate5m = accepted / drafted tokens (left). llm:spec_mean_accept_length:rate5m = 1 + accepted / drafts: tokens emitted per verification step (τ, EAGLE/Medusa; vLLM mean acceptance length) on the right. Native counters advance at request end.

panels.title: Per-position conditional acceptance α_k
panels.description: llm:spec_conditional_acceptance{position=k}: α_0 = accepted at position 0 / drafts; α_k = accepted at k / accepted at k−1 (probability position k is accepted given k−1 was). Leviathan et al. / vLLM per-position acceptance.

panels.title: Drafted vs accepted tokens/s
panels.description: rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total) and rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total).

panels.title: Per-request mean acceptance length
panels.description: llamacpp_spec_mean_accept_length: log `mean len` per request with ≥ 100 drafted tokens (shorter requests give degenerate 1.000 values, PN-61).

panels.title: Proxy-side draft acceptance
panels.description: rate(llm_spec_accepted_tokens_total) / rate(llm_spec_draft_tokens_total) from per-request timings.draft_n / draft_n_accepted, by server and model (cross-check of the native ratio).

targets.expr: sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_spec_accepted_tokens_total{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (server, model) (rate(llm_spec_draft_tokens_total{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prefill progress
panels.description: llamacpp_slot_prompt_processed_tokens / (prompt tokens of the active request, approximated by llamacpp_slot_kv_tokens − llamacpp_slot_decoded_tokens) from /slots.

targets.expr: max by (server, model, slot) (llamacpp_slot_prompt_processed_tokens{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}) / clamp_min(max by (server, model, slot) (llamacpp_slot_kv_tokens{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}) - max by (server, model, slot) (llamacpp_slot_decoded_tokens{server=~"$server",model=~"$model"}), 1)

panels.title: Slot tokens
panels.description: /slots gauges per slot: llamacpp_slot_prompt_processed_tokens (prefill progress), llamacpp_slot_prompt_cache_tokens (reused from cache), llamacpp_slot_decoded_tokens (generated so far), llamacpp_slot_kv_tokens (held).
